epistemological_metadata.spatial_resolution_note: Mesoscale precipitation and land-surface assimilation (ERA5-Land / GPM IMERG ~9-11 km) cannot resolve individual 2-15 km2 Tunari torrenteras. Therefore, precipitation is used strictly at its valid mesoscale sector scale to compute Multi-Day Antecedent Precipitation Index (API) and root-zone soil moisture pre-conditioning.
